description: This Kotlin file defines the CheckoutActivity class, which manages the checkout screen in an Android app. It handles displaying the order total, initiating the checkout process, and showing the order result or error message.

classes.name: CheckoutActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that manages the checkout process, including displaying the total, initiating a mock login, performing checkout, and displaying results or errors.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Overrides AppCompatActivity's onCreate method to initialize the checkout UI, load order summary, and set up the checkout button's click listener to perform checkout asynchronously.
